study type: Three studies were conducted: (1) randomized controlled double-blinded trial, (2) population-based observational study, (3) register-based cohort study
exposure: Duration of the third stage of labor
outcome: Need for red blood cell transfusion
cohort: Varied depending on study: (1) 249 women with severe PPH, (2) 245 women receiving =10 RBCs due to PPH, (3) 43,357 vaginal deliveries
finding: Improved diagnosis of the causes of PPH, particularly retained placenta, and early recognition and treatment of coagulopathy are important for reducing severe PPH and minimizing associated maternal morbidity.
